changeinfo.changes:
Patch 1.01 Optimised salvage Moolah now attracted in a much better way Fixed Japanese line breaking bugs Fixed localisation issues in Korean Rebalanced endgame enemy damage multipliers General bug fixes General optimisations Added a New Game + feature Once the player beats the final boss, they can start a NG+ NG+ can be repeated a number of times Each NG+ adds an indestructible drone with heavy firepower Each NG+ increases the level and drop rate of enemies When selecting NG+ objectives remain completed however stats are reset (enemies killed etc)
Patch 1.02 Fixed frequent out of memory crashes (sincere apologies this took a while). Optimised planet user interface so tapping tycoon trophy is 100% achievable now. Removed Stats and Tutorial log as they were causing significant memory leaks. Optimised memory usage throughout game. Reduced draw calls in space for minor FPS gains during gameplay. Optimised executive menu for large FPS gains in minigames.
Patch 1.03 Many optimisations including: Using IL2CPP Only update currency string when it changes Using PreAllocated Raycasts Moved various systems back into FixedUpdate Moved things into linkLists Reduced NGUI usage Removed speedlines (ironically these were causing huge FPS drops) Fixed recursion errors others... Fixed some more string typos Fixed broken waves
